capabilities: Suppress spellcheck underlines on text wrapped in marker characters
Restrict the rules to chosen folders
Hide marker characters in the editor and reading view
disambiguation: Not a global spellcheck switch; it only suppresses underlines for the word types and folders you configure.
extras: Desktop only; Obsidian's own spellcheck setting must be enabled. It works by setting spellcheck="false" on the marked ranges, so it depends on the editor honoring that attribute, and lines over 10,000 characters are skipped.
intentEvidence: removes red spellcheck squiggles from words you choose, only in the folders you choose
problem: Notes written in a mix of English and another language get every unfamiliar word underlined as a misspelling, even though real typos still need to be flagged.
summary: Plugin that stops Obsidian's spellchecker underlining marked, capitalized and bold words in the folders you choose.
